contexts.text: Those are called mountains who are self-exalted in mind, thus the love of self itself.
Above the head are they who are self-exalted in mind...
There is the worship of self when a man sets himself up on high above another; wherefore the love of self... is called height, loftiness, exaltation. Illustrated.
That all the cupidities were imbued with the love of self, is signified by the daughters having become haughty ().
A self-exalted heart never receives, but a humble one.

He who is of a self-exalted mind is in the love of self, and not only sets himself above others, but also cares nothing for the Divine; consequently he repels the influx of good, and therefore its conjunction with truths...
They who are in faith without charity, are self-exalted...
The Lord powerfully influences those who are humble, but not those who are self-exalted; because the former receive His influx, whereas the latter repel it.
In the world, the love of self is but little reflected about, but only that self-exaltation of mind in external things which is called pride...
It is no criterion how they appear outwardly, whether haughty or humble...
(This thought) can with difficulty be separated from a certain elation of mind...
That in the degree of their elation of heart from dominion... after death they have internal pain from being cast down and derided. Signified. AR 764.
1.2. On the punishment of vastation of those who are self-exalted in mind... SE 1414:end.
His heart is lifted up in his height () = the love of self.
Thou rulest in the lifting up of the sea ()... By the lifting up of the sea, is signified when the natural man exalts itself against the Divine, by denying those things which are of the Church.
By the throne high and lifted up () is signified the Divine proceeding from which is Heaven.
He is lifted up in height... = that he has gloried from intelligence... which glorying, being elation of mind from the love of self, is from the proprium... AE 654:35.

Everyone that is magnificent and high = those who are in the love of self and the love of the world; and everyone that is lifted up and low () = those who are in the love of their Own intelligence. This is further described by the day of Jehovah being upon all cedars that are high and lifted up... upon all the high mountains and the hills that are lifted up...
The elations of man and the strife of tongues () = the evils of falsity and the falsities of evil; for elations are said of the evils which are of the love of self.
The elations of man = the pride of man's Own intelligence.
The elation of Jordan which is wasted () = the Church as to Divine truth introducing.
When they were satiated, then was their heart lifted up () = when from this fulness they had exalted themselves above all, by believing that therefore Heaven was for them and not for others.
Infernal Spirits are elate in mind...
III. The sins from which man must desist, and which he must shun and be averse to, are especially... elations of mind.
Elation of mind exists in the same way with those who are from the common people as with those who are in the highest places.
